tweets.body:
Thrilled to share our research on designing better 3' UTRs for mRNA therapeutics and vaccines!

By integrating high-throughput stability assays, machine learning models, and mRNA domain expertise, we engineered 3' UTRs that improve mRNA stability and protein production in vivo.

tweets.body: Now @riley_mangan using single cell in vivo brain MPRA to find regulatory effects of human accelerated region (HAR) regulatory elements. Finds hominin-specific and cell-type-specific effects! #ashg22

tweets.body: Maya Bose from @theparkerlab with a talk about position-dependent effects of regulatory elements in an MPRA. Many TFBSs had larger effect upstream of promoter vs. downstream (including E2F, ETS), and activity was heavily biased for the forward strand #ashg22

tweets.body: @bowennjin finished up a great talk of promoter kinetics in cell lines: TF binding influences transcriptional burst frequency, not burst size. If frequency/size have opposite effects, they may be masked in classic eQTL studies #ashg22

tweets.title: These TF-eQTLs can help us unlock mechanisms of regulatory variant effects and understand their context specificity across tissues, cell types, and conditions -
tweets.body: These TF-eQTLs can help us unlock mechanisms of regulatory variant effects and understand their context specificity across tissues, cell types, and conditions -- clearly important for understanding any contributions to phenotype and disease. Read the preprint for more :-)

tweets.title: We looked at patterns of 169 TFs vs. 1M variant-gene pairs across GTEx tissues as well as across individuals within 16 tissues. And we found a bunch of TF-eQTLs
tweets.body: We looked at patterns of 169 TFs vs. 1M variant-gene pairs across GTEx tissues as well as across individuals within 16 tissues. And we found a bunch of TF-eQTLs! They're validated by TFBS annotations and experiments, and they overlap GxE and GWAS loci.

tweets.title: Most non-coding regulatory variants probably work by altering transcription factor binding. So we hypothesized that we could find TF mechanisms of eQTLs by find
tweets.body: Most non-coding regulatory variants probably work by altering transcription factor binding. So we hypothesized that we could find TF mechanisms of eQTLs by finding correlations between TFs and eQTL effects.
